verification.method: For each row citing a document and PDF page we hold, every monetary figure in the row must appear on that page. This catches a transcription slip or a citation that has drifted; it does not check that a figure sits on the right LINE of the page.

direct_reader.note: One record per figure the site displays. Supersedes the older page-citation check for these values, which could only test rows whose workbook Source_ID resolved to a held file.
